Moves the plan DRAFT -&gt; PUBLISHED, saves it and queues, in the same database transaction, CapacityPlanPublished plus -- only when the plan has a shortage -- CapacityShortageDetected and BottleneckDetected in the transactional outbox. A relay publishes them to Kafka as CloudEvents (see asyncapi.yaml). Publishing twice is never silent: the second call is a 409 and queues nothing.
